strings.no_apps: No application is playing sound right now
strings.hover_card_d: Hold the pointer on the icon for two seconds to see the device, the volume and the track
strings.w_sub: The program lives in the tray, next to the clock.
strings.w_where: The list and its order are on the Devices tab.
strings.w_hint: No icon by the clock? Windows hides new icons behind the arrow {arrow} — drag it from there onto the taskbar.
strings.cycle_note: Ticked devices take turns each time you click the tray icon. Drag a row to change the order.
strings.cycle_note_right: Ticked devices take turns each time you right-click the tray icon. Drag a row to change the order.
strings.buttons_d_left: Left click switches sound, right click opens the window
strings.buttons_d_right: Right click switches sound, left click opens the window
strings.auto_device_d: The moment this device turns on, sound moves to it. When it turns off, sound goes back to the previous device
strings.dongle_d: Recognised %s. Whether it is on can only be seen through its USB receiver — Windows does not report it
strings.mic_follow_d: Headphones on: the headset's microphone. Headphones off: the laptop's. Pick a microphone yourself and it stays, and this switch turns off
strings.hk_switch_d: Works from any program, even over a fullscreen game
strings.hk_taken: Another program already uses this shortcut — pick a different one
strings.player_d: The media keys and the shortcut control this player, even when the sound comes from another program. Starting it pauses the others. With no player chosen, the command goes to whatever is playing, or to the last player you controlled
strings.player_key_d: Starts the priority player from anywhere. The keyboard Play key goes to whichever player Windows treats as current
strings.autostart_d: The tray icon appears right after you sign in, without a window
strings.comms_d: Discord, Zoom and Teams switch along with everything else. Without this, they stay on the old device
strings.notify_d: A popup with the name of the new device
strings.beep_d: A short tone on the new device
strings.about_text: Switch between speakers and headphones with one click on the tray icon.
strings.g_left_d: Switches sound to the next checked device
strings.msg_none_marked: No device is marked for switching
strings.msg_switch_failed: Windows could not switch the sound to the chosen device
strings.msg_mic_failed: Windows could not switch recording to the chosen microphone
strings.msg_player_dead: %s is not answering — the tab was probably closed
strings.msg_no_engine: The window needs Microsoft WebView2. Switching sound works without it.
strings.dlg_no_engine:
The window needs Microsoft WebView2, and this computer does not have it.

Switching sound from the tray icon works without it.

Open the download page?
strings.learn_open_d: All the files the program keeps on this computer
strings.teach_d: Receiver %s is not known yet. Switch the headset on and off twice, and the program will work out for itself which signal means what — it starts watching straight away, with no new version to wait for
strings.wiz_waiting: Waiting for a signal from the receiver
strings.wiz_ok_d: %s is recognised now, and the program watches it through the receiver. Send this report, and the next version will recognise it for everyone.
strings.wiz_no_d: Nothing in the signals told the headset on from the headset off. Sending them is still worth it: what the program missed, a person may see.
strings.up_store: Updates arrive through the Microsoft Store, on their own.
strings.up_why_signature: the downloaded file is not signed by the developer
strings.up_why_release: the release description does not look right
strings.autostart_store: Windows keeps the startup list for programs from the Store. The switch for this program is there.
strings.tray_dock: Show the tray icon as well
strings.tray_dock_d: The program is shown in Master Control Dock. The tray icon switches the same way
strings.hide_blur: Hide when left in the background
strings.hide_blur_d: The window hides after 20 seconds behind other windows, unless the pointer is over it
